name: Unisplendour Corporation Limited
summary: Unisplendour Corporation Limited, a technology company, provides digital and artificial intelligence solutions in China and internationally. The company operates through Digital Business, Distribution Business, and Others segments. It provides a full stack of intelligent information and communication infrastructure, including networks, computing, storage, cloud computing, security, and smart terminals, as well as cloud and intelligent platforms, and solutions for digital transformation and intelligent upgrading.
